findings.description: The woman's torso emerges from the car's hood/cowl directly in front of the windshield, with her crossed arms resting on the hood. There is no opening there. She is not seated inside the cabin (she's in front of the windshield glass) and not standing beside the car (the fender and hood run continuously beneath her). Her body is effectively merged into the car's bodywork for the whole clip.

In the opening wide shot, the area to the left of the car is an unmarked roadside/dirt shoulder and desert scrub with no utility poles. As the camera pushes in, the same area becomes a paved two-lane highway with a yellow dashed center line and a row of wooden utility poles. These elements are not visible in the wide shot, so the car seems to sit on a different road than where it started.

In the first ~5 s her hair is nearly still. From about 05:50 it suddenly blows strongly sideways, as if in strong wind or a moving car, but the car is parked and the desert scrub shows no matching motion.
The front plate reads as garbled pseudo-text ('STE 97' / 'STEI97') with malformed glyphs typical of generated text.
The car body goes from a warm cream/pale yellow in the wide shot to a cool pale mint-white in the close-up. The shift is larger than the lighting change from the camera move would explain.
